### Our Advocate
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/our-advocate
Passage: 1 John 2:1
Points:
- Believers experience an ongoing tension between the call to holiness and the reality of falling into sin.
- The gift of forgiveness must never be turned into an excuse for casual or willful sin.
- Jesus satisfies the righteous justice of God because He took our penalty upon Himself at the cross.
- Christ ministers as our heavenly Advocate, applying His finished sacrifice on our behalf before the Father.
- Awareness of personal sin should drive believers back to repentance and trust in Christ rather than despair.

### Cheap Grace - One Year Devotions for Men
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/cheap-grace-one-year-devotions-for-men-february-2.html
Passage: 1 John 2:1
Points:
- God's grace is abused when forgiveness is claimed without a heart for repentance and discipleship.
- John writes so believers will avoid sin, not to grant permission to live comfortably in it.
- Remembering that Christ suffered crucifixion as our atoning sacrifice shows how serious sin truly is.
- Victory over sin is found by obeying God's commands and adopting Jesus as our daily role model.
- Living in Christ requires the costly discipline of walking just as Jesus walked.
